claims.text: If IOP rises: brimonidine 0.2% or 0.15% BID, alone or w timolol 0.5% BID
claims.quote: If pressure rises, timolol 0.5% twice a day, brimonidine 0.2% or 0.15% twice a day, or both are given.

claims.text: Brimonidine: CI in neonates and infants <2 y/o
claims.quote: Brimonidine tartrate ophthalmic solution is contraindicated in neonates and infants (pediatric patients younger than 2 years old). [see Use in Specific Populations (8.4)].
